title: ROLE-WORK-2: the Worker-native executor takes waiting dispatches, not only ops/priority-queue.json
body:
**Owner:** Staff (platform)
**Trigger:** GET /api/v1/status reports finding needs-executor
**Done check:** grep:seed/worker/src/nativeexec.js::waiting
**Status:** closed

ROLE-WORK-1 makes roles consume their dispatches: probes the Worker can evaluate (file:, metric:, item_done:, successor:, TICKFAIL) close the item with a verified outcome; the rest move to dispatch status waiting with one needs_executor outcome. The executor currently reads only ops/priority-queue.json, so D1 items whose probe needs a code change wait forever. This item makes runNative take the oldest waiting D1 dispatch first (title, done check and closing probe as the prompt), open the PR on worker/<item>, and leave closing to role-work when the probe passes after merge. Closing probe: needs-executor count falls and an item with a file: probe closes after a worker/* PR merges.

**Disposition:** shelved (ttl, 2026-11-21T18:12:26Z, DISPOSE-1)

**Evidence:** open 156.9 hours (limit 6 hours) and no loop closed it (SLA-8H-1). Its closing probe still runs on every fleet pass and records `fixed` when it passes; the executor retries it when its open queue is empty (every 30 days at most).
